producer_report.summary: Root cause: the agent driver enforced only a fixed wall-clock deadline and never tracked progress, so a stalled agent looked the same as a slow one and burned the whole deadline. The shared driver loop in claude.rs now records the time of each stream line. If the agent stays silent for a third of its timeout (at least 2s), the loop kills it and returns TimedOut with the detail 'stalled: no output for Ns'. Existing timed-out work retention applies unchanged. Added stall_window and stall_reason helpers in procs.rs. Added tests for a stalled agent, a chatty agent that must not be stopped, and the window rule. Added a Fixed entry to CHANGELOG.md. I ran only the athena-agent tests, and all pass. fmt, clippy and the full workspace tests are left to Athena.

criteria_check.criterion: The change description names the root cause: the driver enforces only a fixed wall-clock deadline and never tracks progress, so a stalled agent is indistinguishable from a slow one.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md Fixed entry and the comment in the claude.rs driver loop name this root cause.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs runs a stand-in agent that emits nothing and hangs, with a long timeout. It asserts the driver ends it well before the deadline, with outcome TimedOut and a detail that says it stalled. It fails on the base commit and passes with the change. Run: cargo test -p athena-agent.
criteria_check.evidence: a_stalled_agent_is_stopped_long_before_its_deadline: hang mode, 12s timeout, asserts elapsed <10s, TimedOut, detail contains 'stalled'. Passes in cargo test -p athena-agent. On base the run lasts the full 12s, so it fails. I did not run it on the base. The stand-in emits one init line and then goes silent.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows an agent that keeps emitting stream lines past the stall window is not killed early, and the existing deadline test (detail 'deadline of 2s reached') still passes. Run: cargo test -p athena-agent.
criteria_check.evidence: an_agent_that_keeps_emitting_past_the_stall_window_is_not_stopped (chatty mode, lines for 7s against a 4s window) ends in Success. a_timed_out_invocation_is_timed_out_with_a_lower_bound still passes: the stall window is None for a 2s timeout.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets, and cargo test --workspace all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran only the athena-agent tests.

criteria_check.criterion: The stall rule is implemented once in the shared driver loop, not per role or per job, so every agent role gets it.
criteria_check.evidence: The rule is in the single invoke loop in claude.rs, with stall_window and stall_reason in procs.rs. There are no per-role changes.

open_issues: I did not edit crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, which the brief lists as a deliverable. The existing TimedOut handling already covers stalled kills.

The stall window is a third of the deadline with a 2s floor, so 600s of silence for a 1800s producer. That is longer than the roughly 10 minutes the introspections suggested only if the producer timeout is raised.
learnings: The driver loop is in claude.rs invoke. TimedOut outcomes already reach keep_timed_out_work in athena-core, so run/mod.rs needed no change.
